text:
Maria (PM): Quick kickoff—need a compact alignment thread on the enterprise compliance roadmap we promised to customers. Focus: audit ingest/retention, BYOK/KMS handshake, SOC2/ISO evidence export, and ops/playbook for legal holds.
Ajay (Eng): +1. Can we agree on what 'retention' means per surface (audit logs vs request logs vs payloads)?
Lex (Security): We should separate integrity/audit trails (must keep) from user payloads (PII). Different retention tiers.
Taylor (Legal): Customers expressly asked for 7y export for evidence in some contracts. We need a path for exceptions.
Jamie (SRE): Ops concerns: ingestion volume spike protection and search latency for archived logs. Need SLOs for query time on warm vs cold.
Olivia (CS): Several customers already asking about BYOK + long retention combo. They want proof it won’t break restore/exports.
Sam (Sales): Also hearing buyers want a single checkbox in the contract: "retain audit evidence for X years" — we need a defensible matrix to hand them.
deploy-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/retention-matrix-draft (stub)
Maria (PM): Proposal: 3 tiers — short (90d), medium (2y), long (7y). Default short for payloads, medium for operational audit, long for legal evidence export. Thoughts?
Ajay (Eng): Implementation-wise: store metadata indexed for medium+; cold archive blobs for long. Need retention tags on write and lifecycle TTL.
Lex (Security): BYOK implications: if a customer rotates or revokes keys, long-retained encrypted blobs must remain accessible. We need a key escrow / key-wrapping policy for exported evidence.
Taylor (Legal): Key escrow is OK if customer signs. Must add explicit contract language about escrow and export responsibilities.
Jamie (SRE): For SLOs: propose query latency targets: warm (<=500ms), cold (<=5s for paginated results). Also retention restore SLA: 24-72h for bulk export?
Olivia (CS): Customers we pilot with will require runbooks and a sample export. Can we surface an evidence export preview in Console?
Sam (Sales): A preview + signed runbook will help close enterprise deals. Also pricing note: long retention must have clear cost pass-through.
Ajay (Eng): Tech risk: audit log size growth; need sampling or indexing choices. Suggest default full ingest + optional sampling for high-frequency traces.
Maria (PM): Launch criteria draft: 1) End-to-end export (7y) worked for 2 pilot customers; 2) BYOK handshake + escrow doc published; 3) Console UX for retention settings + preview; 4) Ops runbook and SLOs published.
Lex (Security): Add security acceptance: cryptographic proof of chain-of-custody for exports (signed manifest + checksums).
Taylor (Legal): And legal acceptance: contract clause templates and approved customer messaging.
Jamie (SRE): Operational gating: simulated 3x ingestion spike and restore drill success. Also rollback plan if export queue backlog exceeds threshold.
Ajay (Eng): Quick sketch of retention tag schema:
```
- retention_tier: short|medium|long
- retain_until: 2029-03-01T00:00:00Z
- encrypted_with_kms: kms-key-id or null
```
Maria (PM): Nice. Who owns end-to-end delivery? I propose Ajay lead eng, Lex lead security, Jamie lead ops, Taylor legal, Olivia pilot coordination.
Ajay (Eng): I'll take eng lead but need 2 ICs and one infra sprint to wire lifecycle policies.
Lex (Security): I'll lead security and propose a small subteam to design escrow and signed-manifest format.
Jamie (SRE): Ops can own runbook + drills. Need templates for playbook steps.
Olivia (CS): I'll identify 2 pilot customers (one SaaS, one regulated). They can validate export + BYOK flow.
Sam (Sales): I'll flag any contracts in flight that need exceptions and prioritize them.
Maria (PM): Timeline proposal: alpha in 6 weeks (internal), beta with pilots in 12 weeks, GA in 20 weeks. Is that realistic?
Ajay (Eng): 6-week alpha is tight but doable if scope limited to audit logs + medium retention. BYOK + long export in beta.
Lex (Security): Agree to phased scope. Will prepare threat model for BYOK escrow and export.
Taylor (Legal): I'll draft contract language and an escrow consent form.
Jamie (SRE): I'll schedule a restore drill in week 10.
Olivia (CS): I'll prep pilot onboarding checklist and success criteria.
Maria (PM): Risks: storage cost, key-revocation edge cases, search latency, legal hold complexity. Mitigations?
Ajay (Eng): Mitigate with lifecycle cold storage + paid addons for long retention. Key revocation handled by escrow policy. Search latency by indexing metadata only.
Lex (Security): For revocation, we need explicit customer opt-in to escrow. No automatic escrow without consent.
Taylor (Legal): Add opt-in flow to contract and a discrete checkbox during onboarding.
Sam (Sales): Pricing approach: baseline storage + per-GB cold archive. Need clear messaging for renewal.
Maria (PM): Action items: Ajay - tech spike for lifecycle + index plan (due EOW). Lex - escrow spec + signed-manifest schema (due EOW). Jamie - restore drill plan (due +10 days). Taylor - contract language draft (due EOW). Olivia - pilot list + invites (due +5 days). Sam - list in-flight contracts (due +3 days).
Ajay (Eng): Acknowledged. I'll drop a short RFC by Friday.
Lex (Security): Acknowledged.
Jamie (SRE): Acknowledged.
Taylor (Legal): Acknowledged.
Olivia (CS): Acknowledged.
Sam (Sales): Acknowledged. :thumbsup:
Maria (PM): Great—next sync in 1 week. If anything blocks, ping this thread and @marie for escalation. :spiral_calendar:
